# Video API parameter fixtures

These are small normalized factual parameter fixtures derived from public API
references retrieved on 2026-10-26, not complete or verbatim document copies.
The adjacent provenance files record the exact raw and normalized source hashes,
URLs, retrieval time and fixture hash. Unused prose/examples are excluded.

The exact downloaded HTML can also be replayed offline with
`GATEWAY_OPERATIONAL_SOURCE_FIXTURES=/path/to/snapshots`; that directory contains
`wan3.html`, `wan27.html`, `happyhorse.html` and `seedance.md`. The tests never
fetch sources or call generation APIs. Current runtime descriptors remain the
authority for supported options. An undocumented native selector remains a review
finding; the fixture must not manufacture it to produce complete coverage.
